finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The function get_error_message might return user-controlled or attacker-controlled data, and printf does not sanitize the input before using it.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that printf is called with a constant format string "Error: %s\n" and the user data is passed as a separate argument. Since the format string is a compile‑time constant, the user data cannot influence the format string or cause command execution. No other code paths or checks are required to refute the claim.
